paper_id: Discriminative Neural Sentence Modeling by Tree-Based Convolution__oa_W2963872035
title: Discriminative Neural Sentence Modeling by Tree-Based Convolution
motivation: CNNs有效但丢失结构信息,RNNs保留结构但路径过长导致梯度消失和学习困难
problem_framing: 能否以短传播路径有效利用句子结构进行判别式句子建模
key_insight: 树上的卷积窗口让任意位置的节点都有到输出层的短传播路径
method_signature: TBCNN基于句法树滑动子树特征检测器,max pooling聚合
evaluation_criteria: 情感分析(5类/2类)和问题分类的准确率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 复杂pooling效果提升不大,模型对pooling方法不敏感;c-TBCNN比d-TBCNN略差
evidence_for_taste: structures are important when modeling sentences
pooling is very effective and efficient
more effective than RNNs to a large extent
thinking_moves: 从CNNs和RNNs各自的缺陷出发提出组合问题
通过传播路径长度理论分析架构优劣
用pooling设计准则约束方案探索空间
通过可视化验证特征提取的判别性
cites_own_work: Mou et al., 2014 (TBCNN for programming language)
